The conflict is real: it comes from the Microsoft Fluent Android Community file as exported on 2026-10-11. The call and the deciders are the demo's placeholder owners, not a real Fluent team's. Replace them with your own team's call, or add one with `civic decide`.

decisions.title: Update the Android kit with an Outlined button
decisions.rationale: The Android kit predates Fluent Android's Compose controls and draws only Primary and Text buttons. Compose ships OutlinedButton for Brand outline, and the contract keeps it, so Design adds an Outlined button to the kit. Until it lands, Android designers take Brand outline from the contract, not the kit.
decisions.revisitTrigger: The kit gains an Outlined button, or Compose drops OutlinedButton.
